content.value: Suppose, in a project you have some sensor data in the form of short (16-bit values) array named “givenData”. You have to write those data in a file named “data.check" using fwri te function and after that you need to read those data from "data.check" file using fread and store it to “outputData" array. Write a C program for it.
Write a Makefile whose default target builds the program app, and which only preprocesses and recompiles individual files as needed. Your Makefile must consider the dependency between the files.
